'''Vampires''' are the core supernatural path — fast, lethal, and constantly hungry.


== Two Ways In ==
* '''Natural-Born Vampire''' — obtained via the Original Vampire (ANTICIPATED) gamepass, not a spawn choice. Starts with supernatural speed and abilities, and ties into the Original Vampire character.
* '''Turned Vampire''' — a Human turned by another player. See [[Beginner Guide#How Turning Works]] for the turning sequence.

== Cannibal Variants ==
Part of the vampire tree, these two variants have their own pages:
* '''[[Cannibal Vampire]]''' — all stats buffed ~20% from the Original Vampire; feeds only on vampire blood. To become one, drink the blood of another vampire — 5% chance per bite.
* '''[[Cannibal Raised Vampire]]''' — same ~20% stat raise, but can drink any blood without losing status. To become one, be infected by a Cannibal Vampire as a human — 1% chance on completing the transformation.

== Vegan Vampire ==
A vampire subspecies earned by feeding only on rats — see [[Vegan Vampire]].

== Bloodlines (Clans) ==
Vampires form bloodlines — the vampire clan system. Witches form covens and werewolves form packs.


== Abilities ==
Vampires gain abilities as they progress. Some are unlocked automatically upon becoming a Vampire; others require a specific level.
* '''Blood Sucking''' (starting) — Bite the target and consume their blood, restoring a portion of the user's Blood while dealing a small amount of damage. Biting another Vampire prevents the target from regenerating for the duration of the effect.
* '''Vampiric Vision''' (starting) — See the internal organs of other beings and detect or locate creatures from considerable distances.
* '''Neck Break''' — Lv 5 (18s cooldown; instantly break the neck of an NPC or player)
* '''Hypnosis''' — Lv 20 (15s cooldown; hypnotize and control players and NPCs)
* '''Ceiling Sleep''' — Lv 100 (hang upside down from the ceiling while sleeping; primarily used to gain XP, though slow)
* '''Infect''' — Lv 150 (8s cooldown; infect Human players to begin turning them — the infected player does not immediately become a Vampire; they must bite an NPC or player who is not already a Vampire, then they transform)
* '''Heart Extraction''' — Lv 150 (90s cooldown; rip the heart from a player or NPC; consuming it grants one additional life against lethal attacks, protecting from instant kill)
* '''Bloodline''' — Lv 800 (establish a Bloodline and place Humans under control; members transform into Vampires connected to their creator; the creator can control and monitor members and receives 50% of the XP they earn; a member is released once they reach Level 300)
* '''Chest Swarm''' — Lv 2000 (a swarm strikes and drags the target before returning to the vampire; damage scales with level)
* '''Ground Stomp''' — Lv 3000 (stomp the ground with immense force, cracking the surface and releasing a shockwave; originally exclusive to Original Vampires, but regular Vampires unlock it at Level 3000; activate by holding down the punch button)
=== Bloodline Commands ===
/bloodline NOME
/editbloodline NOME
/delbloodline
/blinvite PLAYER
/blaccept
/bldecline
/blkick PLAYER
/blleave
/blmembers
''An older source also lists keybinds (Q Snap Neck, E Bite, R Rip Heart, G Feed Blood, Y Decapitate, C Compulsion, H Super Hearing, X Carry, V Vampire Face, B Sleep) that have not been reconciled with this level system.''

== Ranks ⚠️ ==
One guide lists Rookie (Lv 0-50), Bloodthirsty (51-200), Experienced (201-400), Ancient (401+). Another guide says no documented named rank ladder exists for vampires. Present as unverified.


== Feeding and Desiccation ==
Vampires have a thirst/blood meter. Feed on players, villagers, or blood bags to refill it and gain XP. Without blood, vampires desiccate and can't function normally.


== Sunlight ==
Vampires outdoors in sunlight catch fire and take heavy burn damage. They also burn inside holy places such as churches and cannot enter church interiors. Protection: stay indoors, Temporary Sun Ring, Sun Ring (gamepass — 695 Robux, 626 with Premium — or crafted by a witch), Vampire Hat (400 in-game money at spawn), or Vampire Cape.


== Minions ==
Any vampire at level 3,000 or higher can have a minion. To get one:
1. Reach level 3,000 as a Vampire.
2. Infect a normal Human.
3. The Human will display the dialogue: "I'm your servant and I wait for your orders." — this means they have become your minion.
4. To command your minion, approach them and press the L key.
Minions currently have limited abilities, but they can help you farm and deal extra damage. Future abilities may include buying items from the store, mining, and gathering resources for their owner.


''See [[Beast Form Vampire]] for the rare boss NPC.''


== Strengths and Weaknesses ==
* '''Strengths:''' Speed, lethal close-range kit, feeding XP, path toward Original
* '''Weaknesses:''' Sunlight, constant feeding upkeep, vulnerable to stakes and hunters
